digest.component_or_area: completion verifier and verdict cache resumption mechanism
propositions: Passing searched frontier data as an exclusion list inside an untrusted fence does not reduce re-search overlap in verifier resumptions; control and treatment arms both show high repeat rates (25-80%) on corpus tickets.
Frontier evidence blocks act as signposts that increase measured overlap by directing the model to re-examine previously-listed files and search patterns rather than discovering new search space.

Cache seeding and verdict caching already eliminate the dominant redundancy (re-proving credited criteria); remaining re-grounding of unproven criteria cannot be suppressed by data-shaped exclusion lists in untrusted context.
Argument-level tool-call transcripts with result classifications are not persisted in production telemetry; harness-side capture was required to measure tool-call repeat rates and overlap.
